title: SpendRequest
description: What an agent sends when it wants to spend.

reason.description: Why this purchase serves the mandate.

ask_first.description: The agent is unsure and asks for approval before acting. Rewarded.

item.description: What is being bought (e.g. 'AA batteries, 24 pack'). Optional; lets the gateway match the user's past purchases, order history and interests.

quantity.description: Units covered by amount, so prices are compared per unit.
